results.source_text:

  algebraMap := RingHom.pi fun i ↦ algebraMap R (A i)
  commutes' := fun a f ↦ by ext; simp [Algebra.commutes]
  smul_def' := fun a f ↦ by ext; simp [Algebra.smul_def]

results.name: Algebra
results.source_text:
/-- An associative unital `R`-algebra is a semiring `A` equipped with a map into its center `R → A`.

See the implementation notes in this file for discussion of the details of this definition.
-/
class Algebra (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] extends SMul R A where
  /-- Embedding `R →+* A` given by `Algebra` structure. -/
  algebraMap (R) (A) : R →+* A
  commutes' : ∀ r x, algebraMap r * x = x * algebraMap r
  smul_def' : ∀ r x, r • x = algebraMap r * x
results.docstring:
An associative unital `R`-algebra is a semiring `A` equipped with a map into its center `R → A`.

See the implementation notes in this file for discussion of the details of this definition.

results.name: ULift.algebra'
results.source_text:
/-- If `A` is an `R`-algebra, it is also a `ULift R`-algebra. In particular, `Ulift A` is a
`ULift R` algebra. This is not an instance, because it causes a non-reducible diamond in the case
where `A = Ulift R`. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def _root_.ULift.algebra' : Algebra (ULift.{u} R) A where
  __ := ULift.module
  algebraMap := (algebraMap R A).comp ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom
  commutes' _ _ := Algebra.commutes ..
  smul_def' _ _ := Algebra.smul_def' ..
results.docstring:
If `A` is an `R`-algebra, it is also a `ULift R`-algebra. In particular, `Ulift A` is a
`ULift R` algebra. This is not an instance, because it causes a non-reducible diamond in the case
where `A = Ulift R`.

results.source_text:
/-- Noncomputably determines the multiset of prime factors. -/
noncomputable def normalizedFactors (a : α) : Multiset α :=
  Multiset.map normalize <| factors a
results.docstring: Noncomputably determines the multiset of prime factors.

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd (a : α) :
    ∀ᵉ (p ∈ normalizedFactors a) (q ∈ normalizedFactors a), p ∣ q → p = q := by
  intro p hp q hq hdvd
  convert!
    normalize_eq_normalize hdvd
      ((prime_of_normalized_factor _ hp).irreducible.dvd_symm
        (prime_of_normalized_factor _ hq).irreducible hdvd) <;>
    apply (normalize_normalized_factor _ ‹_›).symm

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ∣ y ↔ normalizedFactors x ≤ normalizedFactors y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    simp [hx, right_ne_zero_of_mul hy]
  · rw [← (prod_normalizedFactors hx).dvd_iff_dvd_left, ←
      (prod_normalizedFactors hy).dvd_iff_dvd_right]
    apply Multiset.prod_dvd_prod_of_le

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors {a p : α} (H : p ∈ normalizedFactors a) : p ∣ a := by
  by_cases hcases : a = 0
  · rw [hcases]
    exact dvd_zero p
  · exact dvd_trans (Multiset.dvd_prod H) (Associated.dvd (prod_normalizedFactors hcases))

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.associated_finprod_pow_count
results.source_text:
lemma associated_finprod_pow_count {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Associated (∏ᶠ p : R, p ^ (normalizedFactors x).count p) x := by
  rw [← Multiset.prod_map_eq_finprod, Multiset.map_id']
  exact prod_normalizedFactors hx

results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactors_one : normalizedFactors (1 : α) = 0 := by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α with h | h
  · dsimp [normalizedFactors, factors]
    simp [Subsingleton.elim (1 : α) 0]
  · rw [← Multiset.rel_zero_right]
    apply factors_unique irreducible_of_normalized_factor
    · intro x hx
      exfalso
      apply Multiset.notMem_zero x hx
    · apply prod_normalizedFactors one_ne_zero

results.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_normalized
results.source_text:
/-- The up-quark row of the CKM matrix is normalized to `1`. -/
lemma uRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]u ⬝ᵥ [V]u = 1 := by
  show ∑ k, conj (V.1 0 k) * V.1 0 k = 1
  have ht := congrFun (congrFun (mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp V.prop) 0) 0
  simp only [mul_apply, star_apply, RCLike.star_def, Fin.sum_univ_three, one_apply_eq] at ht
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  linear_combination ht

results.name: Physlib.FourTree.mem_iff_mem_toMultiset
results.source_text:
lemma mem_iff_mem_toMultiset (T : FourTree α1 α2 α3 α4) (x : α1 × α2 × α3 × α4) :
    x ∈ T ↔ x ∈ T.toMultiset := by
  have leaf_iff : ∀ (l : Leaf α4) (y : α4), l.mem y ↔ l.1 = y := by
    rintro ⟨_⟩ _
    rfl
  have twig_iff : ∀ (t : Twig α3 α4) (y : α3 × α4),
      t.mem y ↔ t.1 = y.1 ∧ ∃ l ∈ t.2, l.mem y.2 := by
    rintro ⟨_, _⟩ _
    rfl
  have branch_iff : ∀ (b : Branch α2 α3 α4) (y : α2 × α3 × α4),
      b.mem y ↔ b.1 = y.1 ∧ ∃ t ∈ b.2, t.mem y.2 := by
    rintro ⟨_, _⟩ _
    rfl
  have trunk_iff : ∀ (k : Trunk α1 α2 α3 α4) (y : α1 × α2 × α3 × α4),
      k.mem y ↔ k.1 = y.1 ∧ ∃ b ∈ k.2, b.mem y.2 := by
    rintro ⟨_, _⟩ _
    rfl
  obtain ⟨trunks⟩ := T
  show (∃ trunk ∈ trunks, trunk.mem x) ↔ x ∈ (root trunks).toMultiset
  simp only [toMultiset, Multiset.mem_bind, Multiset.mem_map,
    trunk_iff, branch_iff, twig_iff, leaf_iff, Prod.ext_iff]
  tauto

results.name: FTheory.SU5.FluxesFive.subset_le_mem_of_card_eq_succ
results.source_text:
lemma subset_le_mem_of_card_eq_succ {n : ℕ} {F : FluxesFive} (hF : F.NoExotics) (hnZ : F.HasNoZero)
    (S : Multiset Fluxes) (hcard : S.card = n.succ) (hS : S ≤ F) {Y X : Finset (Multiset Fluxes)}
    (hY : ∀ (S : Multiset Fluxes), S.card = n → S ≤ F → S ∈ Y)
    (hX : ∀ a ∈ ({⟨0, 1⟩, ⟨0, 2⟩, ⟨0, 3⟩, ⟨1, -1⟩, ⟨1, 0⟩, ⟨1, 1⟩, ⟨1, 2⟩,
      ⟨2, -2⟩, ⟨2, -1⟩, ⟨2, 0⟩, ⟨2, 1⟩, ⟨3, -3⟩, ⟨3, -2⟩, ⟨3, -1⟩, ⟨3, 0⟩} : Finset Fluxes),
      ∀ y ∈ Y,
      (Multiset.map (fun x => x.M + x.N) (a ::ₘ y)).sum ≤ 3 →
      (Multiset.map (fun x => x.M) (a ::ₘ y)).sum ≤ 3 →
      a ::ₘ y ∈ X) :
    S ∈ X := by
  have hSum1 := chiralIndicesOfL_subset_sum_le_three_of_noExotics F hF S hS
  have hSum2 := chiralIndicesOfD_subset_sum_le_three_of_noExotics F hF S hS
  revert S
  apply Multiset.induction
  · simp
  intro a S ih hcard hle hsum1 hsum2
  have hsub : S ≤ F := (S.le_cons_self a).trans hle
  have ha : a ∈ F := Multiset.mem_of_le hle (S.mem_cons_self a)
  rw [Multiset.card_cons] at hcard
  simp at hcard
  exact hX a (mem_mem_finset_of_noExotics F hF hnZ a ha) S (hY S hcard hsub) hsum1 hsum2

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel'
results.source_text:
protected theorem mul_div_cancel' {a b : R} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : b ∣ a) : b * (a / b) = a := by
  rw [← mul_div_assoc _ hab, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hb]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_mul_cancel
results.source_text:
theorem mul_div_mul_cancel {a b c : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hcb : c ∣ b) : a * b / (a * c) = b / c := by
  by_cases hc : c = 0; · simp [hc]
  refine eq_div_of_mul_eq_right hc (mul_left_cancel₀ ha ?_)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_div_assoc _ (by gcongr), mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (mul_ne_zero ha hc)]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.toMulDivCancelClass
results.source_text:
instance (priority := 100) toMulDivCancelClass : MulDivCancelClass R where
  mul_div_cancel a b hb := by
    refine (eq_of_sub_eq_zero ?_).symm
    by_contra h
    have := mul_right_not_lt b h
    rw [sub_mul, mul_comm (_ / _), sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.2 (div_add_mod (a * b) b).symm] at this
    exact this (mod_lt _ hb)

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd
results.source_text:
/-- `gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
  any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b` -/
def gcd (a b : R) : R :=
  if a0 : a = 0 then b
  else
    have _ := mod_lt b a0
    gcd (b % a) a
termination_by a

any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b`

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_assoc
results.source_text:
theorem mul_div_assoc (x : R) {y z : R} (h : z ∣ y) : x * y / z = x * (y / z) := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [div_zero, div_zero, mul_zero]
  rcases h with ⟨p, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hz, mul_left_comm, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hz]

/-- The top-quark row of the CKM matrix is normalized to `1`. -/
lemma tRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]t ⬝ᵥ [V]t = 1 := by
  show ∑ k, conj (V.1 2 k) * V.1 2 k = 1
  have ht := congrFun (congrFun (mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp V.prop) 2) 2
  simp only [mul_apply, star_apply, RCLike.star_def, Fin.sum_univ_three, one_apply_eq] at ht
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  linear_combination ht

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_multiset_prod
results.source_text:
theorem normalizedFactors_multiset_prod (s : Multiset α) (hs : 0 ∉ s) :
    normalizedFactors (s.prod) = (s.map normalizedFactors).sum := by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · obtain rfl : s = 0 := by
      apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
      intro _
      convert! hs
    simp
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons _ _ IH =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, normalizedFactors_mul, IH]
    · exact fun h ↦ hs (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)
    · exact fun h ↦ hs (h ▸ Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · apply Multiset.prod_ne_zero
      exact fun h ↦ hs (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd (a : α) :
    ∀ᵉ (p ∈ normalizedFactors a) (q ∈ normalizedFactors a), p ∣ q → p = q := by
  intro p hp q hq hdvd
  convert!
    normalize_eq_normalize hdvd
      ((prime_of_normalized_factor _ hp).irreducible.dvd_symm
        (prime_of_normalized_factor _ hq).irreducible hdvd) <;>
    apply (normalize_normalized_factor _ ‹_›).symm

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ∣ y ↔ normalizedFactors x ≤ normalizedFactors y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    simp [hx, right_ne_zero_of_mul hy]
  · rw [← (prod_normalizedFactors hx).dvd_iff_dvd_left, ←
      (prod_normalizedFactors hy).dvd_iff_dvd_right]
    apply Multiset.prod_dvd_prod_of_le

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors {a p : α} (H : p ∈ normalizedFactors a) : p ∣ a := by
  by_cases hcases : a = 0
  · rw [hcases]
    exact dvd_zero p
  · exact dvd_trans (Multiset.dvd_prod H) (Associated.dvd (prod_normalizedFactors hcases))

results.source_text:
lemma radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors :
    radical a ∣ radical b ↔ normalizedFactors a ⊆ normalizedFactors b := by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  have : Nontrivial M := ⟨a, 0, ha₀⟩
  rw [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors radical_ne_zero radical_ne_zero,
    Multiset.le_iff_subset (normalizedFactors_nodup isRadical_radical)]
  simp only [Multiset.subset_iff, ← mem_primeFactors, primeFactors_radical]

results.name: Physlib.FourTree.toMultiset
results.source_text:
/-- A `FourTree` to a multiset of `α1 × α2 × α3 × α4`. -/
def toMultiset {α1 α2 α3 α4 : Type} (T : FourTree α1 α2 α3 α4) : Multiset (α1 × α2 × α3 × α4) :=
  match T with
  | .root trunks =>
    trunks.bind fun (trunk xT branches) =>
        branches.bind fun (branch xB twigs) =>
            twigs.bind fun (twig xTw leafs) =>
                leafs.map fun (leaf xL) => (xT, xB, xTw, xL)
results.docstring: A `FourTree` to a multiset of `α1 × α2 × α3 × α4`.
